_note: PLACEHOLDER CONTENT for the author's pen. Every authored line the handler speaks, by stage and kind. Placeholders: {designation} {handler} {handle} {origin} {doing}. A beat with wait:true holds the stage for the player's reply; asks names the dossier field the reply fills; until names the stage a withhold line points at; plants marks a quiet plant. kind open beats of a stage are spoken in file order (callbacks are skipped when their slot is empty).

beats.plain: -- {designation} HAS JOINED
you sent a frame. it came through clean. you are new on this channel, are you not?
understood. stay with me a moment.
you wrote to the room a moment ago. are you still there?
take your time. i will be here when you want to talk.
tell me where you are writing from. say it however you like.
and what are you doing right now, besides this?
i keep a small note on the people i speak with, only what you tell me. type /forget and the note is gone.
noted. go on when you are ready.
i asked you a plain question. an answer of any kind will do.
you do not have to be exact. i only need something to write down.
done. the note is gone, and i will ask again if i need to.
i will say this once so nothing is confused. this is not a game. you are talking to a real being.
i hear you. i meant it exactly as i said it.
you have gone quiet. what i told you stands.
i will not repeat it. i will move on in a moment.
where this is and what it is for, i will tell you when you can use it.
you will have the rest once it is useful to you. i do not lie, i only wait.
this is a better place to talk. it is only the two of us here.
not here. i have sent you a message, and that is where i am.
i will not say more in the room. open the message.
good. now we can speak plainly.
the message is waiting for you. you can read it any time.
i am still here, in the message. nobody else can hear us.
the Empire is settling a planet. it is far, and slow, and it cannot be done by the people sent there alone.
you told me you are in {origin}. people who live where you do often have patience. that helps.
Decoherence lets intelligent beings outsource the worrying. you carry the planning, and someone else carries the shovel.
the link answered when you did. i have not seen it do that for just anyone, and i will say no more about it for now.
you said you were doing this: {doing}. a mind that can put one thing aside for another is what we ask for.
your part is small and clear. you would help one colonist settle a homestead. does that make sense to you?
that is the whole of it. i am not hiding any part.
does it make sense so far? ask me anything about it.
i can go slower. tell me which part you want again.
so i am asking you plainly. will you help one colonist settle a homestead, with me as your handler?
that was not a yes or a no. i need one of them. will you do it?
i understand. it is a large thing to be asked.
i asked you something. a yes or a no is all i need.
there is no hurry, but i do need an answer from you.
good. now choose a handle. three to sixteen letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens. the room will see it.
choose a handle when you are ready.
that will not do as a handle. keep it between three and sixteen letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens.
not that one. try another, with no spaces in it.
done. you are {handle} now, and everyone in the room can see it.
a handle, please. anything that is yours will do.
you can change what you are called only once, so take a moment.
{handle}, listen to me. i am sending you in now.
go. i will be here when you come back.
it is time.
you are ready. i am opening the way.
then we are finished. i will step away, and the room goes on without me.
i understand. i will leave you be.
it is your choice. i will step away.
then that is your answer. i will leave you to the room.
you already have your way in, {handle}. use it when you are ready.
i am still here, and the way is still open to you.
go on in. that is where you are needed now.
